title: Fail on dangling cleanup references
decision: SG-0007 should fail loudly if cleanup leaves app-facing references pointing to removed source annotations, removed source-files paths, removed raw source paths, or unresolved development-only source records. The importer should rewrite affected references to retained document/source/regulatory IDs or normalized provenance stubs, or fail with a clear report.
context: Removing source-files, normalizing source records, sanitizing project metadata, and dropping development-only source annotations can leave references behind. Silent dangling references would make later service-backed browsing unreliable.
rationale: A reference-integrity gate catches broken cleanup before SG-0013 consumes the workspace. Failing with a clear report is preferable to letting the browser or service quietly omit metadata or display confusing empty states.
alternatives_considered: Silently drop dangling references during import
Leave dangling references for SG-0013 to tolerate
Keep removed source annotations only to satisfy references
consequences: SG-0007 must include a post-cleanup reference-integrity check
References affected by cleanup should point to retained IDs or normalized provenance stubs
The importer should report unresolved references with enough context to fix them
SG-0013 should only consume epp-full service responses after the integrity check passes
